findings.message: `## Depends on` names `vscode-help-registry`, but no `tickets/vscode-help-registry/ticket.md` exists, and nothing in the repo mentions that stem. This ticket's Scope in says `chupa/help.py` 'gains' a topic and command-map entry, and `tests/integration/test_help.py::test_manifest_covered` 'gains' checks. Criterion 2 runs `tests/unit/test_help.py` and `tests/integration/test_help.py`. The extension code reads `snap.helpPick`, `headerHelp`, `boxHeaderHelp`, `row.help`, `row.next`, `step.help`, `step.tooltip` and Stats `row.tooltip`. None of these files, functions or snapshot fields exist at the review commit, and no existing ticket promises them. The ticket waits on a stem that will never settle, and its criteria cannot be checked against any defined contract.
findings.paved_road: Commit `tickets/vscode-help-registry/ticket.md` from the split. It must create `chupa/help.py` with the command map, the snapshot fields and Stats `tooltip`, `tests/unit/test_help.py`, and `tests/integration/test_help.py::test_manifest_covered`. Then re-review this ticket against it. The alternative is to fold creation of those files into this ticket and add `chupa/observe.py`, `chupa/stats.py`, `tests/unit/test_help.py` and the affected snapshot tests to the fence.

findings.message: This ticket adds a user-visible `chupa.help` command to every view's title menu, plus hover help and welcome views. Scope out defers the matching `vscode-chupa/README.md` `## Help` section and the `docs/how-chupa-works.md` 2.2 and host-contract updates to `vscode-help-docs`, but no such ticket exists. Those docs are outside this fence, so the Review stage's stale or missing doc-update check has no reachable fix, and the documentation change has no owner.
findings.paved_road: Commit `tickets/vscode-help-docs/ticket.md`, which depends on this stem, alongside it. The alternative is to fence `vscode-chupa/README.md`, `docs/how-chupa-works.md` and `chupa/docs/host-contract.md` and add the doc criteria here.

and a doc link, and that `chupa.help` lists every topic. It also gains one sentence each for `chupa.refreshSeconds` and `chupa.unavailableMenuItems`, so every setting's link has a documented target. No heading in this file is renamed.
- `chupa/docs/host-contract.md` `## VS Code extension` gains one sentence naming the Help command and hover help. No heading in this file is renamed.
- `CLAUDE.md` section A and `AGENTS.md` gain this rule, placed right after the "extension is a thin wrapper" rule and outside the `chupa:core` managed block. Its home is this repo, not `CORE_TEMPLATE`, because it governs chupa's own extension and does not apply to hosts:

  ```
  - **Extension help has one source.** Every extension surface a person sees (view, command, setting, header indicator, and each snapshot vocabulary value) shows help: a short description saying what it is, then what comes before and after it, with a link to the doc section that owns the fact. Help comes from `chupa/help.py`, which reuses a code- or doc-owned string (a status reason, a `chupa/docs/host-running.md` verb row) where one exists and writes text only where none does; settings carry theirs in `package.json` `markdownDescription`. A change that adds an extension surface or vocabulary value, or changes behavior a help entry or its linked section describes, updates that entry in the same change. `tests/unit/test_help.py` and `tests/integration/test_help.py` fail on a missing entry or a dead link; keeping the text true is this rule's job.
    Why: help copied into the extension drifts from the code and docs it describes; the snapshot already carried hand-copied verb descriptions (`engineVerbs`) that restated the run guide (2026-11-13).
  ```

Scope out:
- Code, manifest, and test changes belong to `vscode-help-registry` and `vscode-help-surfaces`.
- `chupa/hostfiles.py` `CORE_TEMPLATE` and the `chupa:core` managed block stay as they are.
- `chupa/docs/host-running.md` stays as it is.

## Scope fence
- CLAUDE.md
- AGENTS.md
- docs/how-chupa-works.md
- chupa/docs/host-contract.md
- vscode-chupa/README.md

## Acceptance criteria
1. `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` each contain the `**Extension help has one source.**` rule exactly as quoted in Scope in, after the `<!-- chupa:core end -->` line in `CLAUDE.md`. This is checked by the first `uv run python -c` command in `## Verification`.
2. The docs name the help: `docs/how-chupa-works.md` names `chupa/help.py`, `Before:`, `After:`, `chupa.help`, `chupa.refreshSeconds`, and `chupa.unavailableMenuItems`; `chupa/docs/host-contract.md` names the Help command; `vscode-chupa/README.md` has a `## Help` section. This is checked by the second `uv run python -c` command in `## Verification`.
3. `./dev.py test tests/integration/test_help.py` still passes, so no linked heading was renamed.
4. `./dev.py test` exits 0.

## Verification
```
uv run python -c "import pathlib; c = pathlib.Path('CLAUDE.md').read_text(); a = pathlib.Path('AGENTS.md').read_text(); r = '**Extension help has one source.**'; assert c.index(r) > c.index('<!-- chupa:core end -->') and r in a"
uv run python -c "import pathlib; h = pathlib.Path('docs/how-chupa-works.md').read_text(); assert all(s in h for s in ('chupa/help.py', 'Before:', 'After:', 'chupa.help', 'chupa.refreshSeconds', 'chupa.unavailableMenuItems')); assert 'Help' in pathlib.Path('chupa/docs/host-contract.md').read_text(); assert '## Help' in pathlib.Path('vscode-chupa/README.md').read_text()"
./dev.py test tests/integration/test_help.py
./dev.py test
```

## Definition of rejected
Reject the branch if any of the following holds:
- the new rule is placed inside the `chupa:core` managed block or in `chupa/hostfiles.py` `CORE_TEMPLATE`;
- the rule text differs from the quoted block;
- a heading in `docs/how-chupa-works.md` or `chupa/docs/host-contract.md` is renamed;
- any code, manifest, or test file changes.

## Time budget
- expected: 30m
- stuck: 60m
